---
title: "rePredRet: Retention Time Prediction by Direct System Mapping"
subtitle: "Pre-built models between RepoRT chromatographic systems"
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(rePredRet)
library(knitr)

# Statistics are computed from the published model index, so they are always current
index <- tryCatch(rePredRet_models(), error = function(e) NULL)
has_data <- !is.null(index) && nrow(index) > 0

report_version <- tryCatch(
  readLines("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stanstrup-metabolomics/rePredRet-models/main/report_version.txt",
            warn = FALSE)[1],
  error = function(e) NA_character_
)
```

## Overview

rePredRet is a reimplementation of [PredRet](http://predret.org) that predicts retention times (RTs) by directly mapping between chromatographic systems using monotonically constrained GAMs. It uses data from the [RepoRT repository](https://github.com/michaelwitting/RepoRT) and publishes pre-built models between all RepoRT systems that share enough compounds to [rePredRet-models](https://github.com/stanstrup-metabolomics/rePredRet-models).

To predict RTs in your own chromatographic system, see the [tutorial](tutorial.html). To explore individual models, use the [model viewer](../model_viewer.html).

### Key Statistics

```{r overall-stats}
#| echo: false
if (has_data) {
  stats_table <- data.frame(
    Metric = c(
      "Number of Models",
      "Number of Systems",
      "Total Calibration Points",
      "Median Compounds per Model",
      "Median Absolute Error",
      "Median Prediction Interval Width"
    ),
    Value = c(
      format(nrow(index), big.mark = ","),
      format(length(unique(c(index$sys1_id, index$sys2_id))), big.mark = ","),
      format(sum(index$n_compounds), big.mark = ","),
      format(stats::median(index$n_compounds)),
      sprintf("%.3f min", stats::median(index$median_error)),
      sprintf("%.3f min", stats::median(index$median_ci_width))
    )
  )

  kable(stats_table, col.names = c("Metric", "Value"), align = "lr")
} else {
  cat("The model index could not be loaded.")
}
```

Errors are the median absolute differences between fitted and measured RTs of the calibration compounds of each model; the table shows the median over all models.

### Comparison with Original PredRet Paper

The original PredRet paper (Stanstrup et al. 2015) reported:

| Metric | Paper Value | rePredRet Value |
|--------|-------------|-----------------|
| Median Error | 0.01-0.28 min | `r if (has_data) sprintf("%.3f min", stats::median(index$median_error)) else "N/A"` |

### Data Source

```{r data-info}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
cat("**RepoRT version (commit):**",
    if (is.na(report_version)) "unknown" else
      sprintf("[%s](https://github.com/michaelwitting/RepoRT/tree/%s)", substr(report_version, 1, 7), report_version),
    "\n")
```
